QuestInfo.name: Talking to Stan
QuestInfo.1: At the entrance of Henesys Park, you meet Alex's father, Stan, the chief of Henesys. Before you can even start a conversation, he asks you to get him #b10 #t4000007#s and 30 #t4000002#s#k.
QuestInfo.2: Only after you brought the #t4000007#s and the #t4000002#s did Chief Stan start talking to you.

0.0: You want to talk to me? I'm the chief of this town, and I have no time for conversation. If you really want to talk to me, then collect these materials for the town. #b#e30#n #t4000007#s#k and #b#e60#n #b#t4000002#s#k. Then we'll talk.

1.0:
Who are you? I don't think we've met.
#b#L0# I'm just a traveler. Don't mind me.#l
#L1# I'm here on #p1052000#'s behalf. Just give me five minutes.#l
#L2# Haha...isn't it beautiful today?#l
1.1:
#p1052000#? Ha, I no longer have a son with that name. Get out of here!
#b#L0# Ah... Yes, sir. Sorry for bothering you.#l
#L1# But #p1052000# wants to come home.#l
#L2# Cut it out! #p1052000# is sorry for running away!#l
1.2:
Eh? Confronting me now? Yelling at me in public? Hmm, you must be somebody important. Fine. How's #p1052000# doing?
#b#L0# #p1052000# is having a hard time since he ran away.#l
#L1# #p1052000# is getting sick of wandering around.#l
#L2# Why don't you ask #p1052000# yourself?#l
1.3:
Ask him myself? Hahahaha! I like you. That makes me wonder. What do YOU think of ME?
#b#L0# I think you are a great chief.#l
#b#L1# I think you are too harsh on Alex.#l
#b#L3# I think you hide the fact that you're actually a person of warmth.#l
1.4:
Yes, like you said, I'm the chief, but ever since #p1052000# left, I've been losing face!
#b#L0# #p1052000# knows he made poor decisions, but now he's asking for forgiveness. What he needs right now is a compassionate father.#l
#b#L1# Are you worried less about your son and more about your image in this town? You've got to be kidding me!#l
#b#L2# #p1052000#'s been unsettled since his mother past away. Your strict nature hasn't helped him any. How about forgiving him?#l
1.5: You know THAT much? I suppose it's true that #p1052000# has been more rebellious since Anna passed away. I've been busy with my chiefly duties, and perhaps I've neglected him. Perhaps this is my fault...

0.0: What do you think I am, a tourist attraction? Shame on you...and get out of my face.
0.2: Ah yes, such a beautiful day...or not! I have no time for idle chit chat. Scram!

1.0: What a chicken. You tell me you know #p1052000# and then want to flee when I get angry? I don't even want to speak to you. Get out of here.
1.1: He wants to come home? Hahaha...! That's a lie! I'm sure he's happy that he can do whatever he wants now, especially since he took my money, too.

2.0: He's having a hard time? Good! Please give him this message: #bStay away. Feel the pain. Experience the hard life! Then maybe you'll learn a thing or two about being independent.#k
2.1: Sick of it?! He wants to come home now that he's sick of living alone? Hahahahahahha! As of this moment, I know no #p1052000#! What an ungrateful... Argh.

3.1: You are brutally honest. I usually like honesty, but I don't appreciate your candor one bit right now. Are you trying to make me mad?
3.2: Hahaha! You're either very observant or you're a kiss-up. Either way, it doesn't matter. I'm busy. Scram.

4.0: You don't know #p1052000# like I do. What were you offered in return for helping #p1052000#? It doesn't matter, I can never forgive him. Please leave...
4.1: Maybe, maybe not! But I have responsibilities! I've served longer as chief of this town than you've been alive. Who are you to chastise ME?

item.0: You want to talk to me? I am an elder of this town, I don't have the time to sit around and chat with someone like you. If you really want to talk to me, bring me some materials to repair the town. I might be able to spare some time if you can bring me #b#e10#n #t4000007#s#k and #b#e30#n #t4000002#s#k...
